messages:
From: Isabelle Moreau <isabelle.moreau@vertex-analytics.eu>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Invoice delivery and billing contact — portal vs email

Hi Jonas,

We're starting Redwood services next month and setting up our AP systems. A couple of quick questions so we can process invoices without delays:

- Do you have an invoice delivery option into our procurement portal (we use Coupa/Ariba style SFTP/EDI integration) or will invoices be sent by email only? Our AP policy prefers portal ingestion for automated VAT handling.
- Can you add a PO number field on your invoices and include VAT breakdown line-by-line? Our format requires the vendor VAT ID and the buyer PO on the invoice for payment.
- Who should we list as the billing contact (name/email) for receipts and queries?

I've attached our vendor requirements checklist to this email (vendor_requirements_VA.pdf). If portal delivery is possible, please send instructions and any integration contacts; otherwise we will accept signed PDF invoices to procurement@vertex-analytics.eu, with a CC to finance@vertex-analytics.eu.

Thanks,

Isabelle Moreau
Vendor Management — Vertex Analytics
isabelle.moreau@vertex-analytics.eu
procurement@vertex-analytics.eu

Attachment: vendor_requirements_VA.pdf (1 page)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.inference
To: Isabelle Moreau <isabelle.moreau@vertex-analytics.eu>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 12:04:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Invoice delivery and billing contact — portal vs email

Hi Isabelle,

Thanks — welcome to Redwood. Short answers first: we can support both portal ingestion and emailed PDFs. Portal integrations vary by customer; for Vertex we can do either:

Option A — Portal/SFTP/EDI (preferred for automation):
- We can drop invoices to a secure SFTP or push to an Ariba/Coupa endpoint.
- Requires a one-time vendor integration (we'll exchange certs/credentials).
- We'd include VAT ID and PO on each invoice if you provide the PO in advance.

Option B — Email (fallback):
- We can send a signed PDF to procurement@vertex-analytics.eu and CC finance@vertex-analytics.eu.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm which option you want (Portal or Email).
2) Share the PO template / the exact PO number format (so we print it on the invoice).
3) Send your company VAT ID and the billing contact name/email for our vendor record.

I've attached a proforma template (Redwood_Proforma_Template.pdf) showing where we'll place the PO and VAT lines. If you want portal delivery, loop in whoever owns integrations on your side and I'll have our platform engineer start the onboarding.

If you prefer, I can set up the vendor record now and push the first invoice to SFTP; otherwise we'll email the invoice and add the PO.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0198
